WITH latest_bounded_months AS (SELECT "CompanyId", "PeriodEnd" FROM (SELECT r0."CompanyId" AS "CompanyId", r0."PeriodEnd" AS "PeriodEnd", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r0."CompanyId" ORDER BY r0."PeriodEnd" DESC) AS "PeriodRank" FROM "public"."MonthlyReports" r0 WHERE r0."CompanyId" = @company_id AND r0."ProviderName" = @provider_name AND r0."ReportType" = @report_type AND r0."OutputType" = @output_type AND r0."IsAccepted" = @is_accepted AND r0."RevisionStatus" = @revision_status AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."MonthlyReportLineItems" li0 WHERE li0."MonthlyReportId" = r0."Id" AND li0."ProductCode" = @product_code) GROUP BY r0."CompanyId", r0."PeriodEnd") ranked_latest_months WHERE "PeriodRank" <= @maximum_periods),
eligible_monthly_rows AS (SELECT r."CompanyId" AS "CompanyId", r."PeriodStart" AS "PeriodStart", r."PeriodEnd" AS "PeriodEnd", li."ProductCode" AS "ProductCode", li."Title" AS "ProductTitle", li."SalesAmount" AS "Value", li."Unit" AS "SourceUnit", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r."CompanyId", r."PeriodEnd", li."ProductCode") AS "SamePeriodCandidateCount", r."ProviderName" AS "ProviderName", r."ReportType" AS "ReportType", r."OutputType" AS "OutputType", r."RevisionStatus" AS "RevisionStatus", r."Id" AS "ReportIdentity", r."ExternalReportId" AS "ExternalReportId", li."SourceRowFingerprint" AS "SourceRowFingerprint", li."SourceMultiplicity" AS "SourceMultiplicity" FROM "public"."MonthlyReportLineItems" li JOIN "public"."MonthlyReports" r ON li."MonthlyReportId" = r."Id" WHERE r."CompanyId" = @company_id AND r."ProviderName" = @provider_name AND r."ReportType" = @report_type AND r."OutputType" = @output_type AND r."IsAccepted" = @is_accepted AND r."RevisionStatus" = @revision_status AND li."ProductCode" = @product_code AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest_bounded_months lbm WHERE lbm."CompanyId" = r."CompanyId" AND lbm."PeriodEnd" = r."PeriodEnd")),

SELECT "Value", "PeriodStart", "PeriodEnd", "ProductCode", "SamePeriodCandidateCount", "PreviousPeriodEnd", "PreviousValue", CASE WHEN "PreviousValue" > 0 THEN (("Value" - "PreviousValue") / "PreviousValue") * 100 ELSE NULL END AS "GrowthPercentage", CASE WHEN "PreviousPeriodEnd" IS NULL THEN 'baseline-row' WHEN date_trunc('month', "PreviousPeriodEnd") <> date_trunc('month', "PeriodEnd") - (@comparison_month_offset * INTERVAL '1 month') THEN 'missing-comparison-period' WHEN "PreviousValue" = 0 THEN 'zero-denominator' WHEN "PreviousValue" < 0 THEN 'negative-baseline-unsupported' ELSE 'comparable' END AS "ComparisonStatus", "ProductTitle", "SourceUnit", "CompanyId", "ReportIdentity" AS "ReportId", "ExternalReportId", "SourceRowFingerprint", "SourceMultiplicity" FROM compared_monthly_rows WHERE "LatestProductPeriodRank" = 1 AND "PreviousPeriodEnd" IS NOT NULL AND "PreviousValue" > 0 AND date_trunc('month', "PreviousPeriodEnd") = date_trunc('month', "PeriodEnd") - (@comparison_month_offset * INTERVAL '1 month')  ORDER BY "CompanyId", "PeriodEnd" ASC LIMIT @row_limit OFFSET @row_offset
